response.sql:
WITH spatial_with_project AS (
  SELECT sp.arcref, sp.boxx, sp.boxz, p.fundflux
  FROM scanspatial sp
  INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
project_ratios AS (
  SELECT arcref, fundflux,
    CASE WHEN SUM(boxz) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(boxx) as REAL) / CAST(SUM(boxz) as REAL) ELSE NULL END as ratio
  FROM spatial_with_project
  GROUP BY arcref, fundflux
),
funding_averages AS (
  SELECT fundflux, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM project_ratios
  WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
with_excess AS (
  SELECT pr.arcref, pr.fundflux, pr.ratio, pr.ratio - fa.avg_ratio as excess
  FROM project_ratios pr
  LEFT JOIN funding_averages fa ON pr.fundflux = fa.fundflux
)
SELECT arcref as project_id, fundflux as funding_source, ratio, excess
FROM with_excess
ORDER BY CASE WHEN excess IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each project is associated with exactly one funding source from the projects table. All spatial records linked to a project inherit that single funding source.

The result includes the top 10 projects ranked by excess (ratio minus funding source average), whether above, below, or indeterminately positioned relative to their funding source average. Projects with NULL excess values (due to NULL ratios or missing funding source averages) are sorted last.
